title: Authentication Broker

oauth_pkce.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code registrations must declare PKCE with the S256 challenge method; plain or absent PKCE is rejected.
oauth_pkce.claim_boundary: The contract only records PKCE intent; no live authorization-code exchange is performed. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

oidc.description: OpenID Connect providers are registered with HTTPS authorization and token endpoints and a declared scope set.
oidc.claim_boundary: No discovery document is fetched and no ID token is verified locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

secret_reference.description: Registrations reference credentials only through an opaque credref handle; raw client secrets and tokens are never stored in the contract.
secret_reference.claim_boundary: The contract never materializes the referenced secret; credential-store integration is deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

redirect_validation.description: Every redirect URI must be absolute HTTPS and is validated before an operation is accepted.
redirect_validation.claim_boundary: Validation is structural; no live redirect round-trip is performed. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

refresh.description: A registration may declare refresh support; refresh operations carry only the opaque credential reference.
refresh.claim_boundary: No refresh token is issued, stored, or exchanged locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

reauth.description: A registration may declare reauthentication support; reauthentication operations revalidate the credential reference and redirect URI.
reauth.claim_boundary: No interactive provider session is started locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

revoke.description: A registration may declare revocation support; revoke operations reference the same opaque credential handle and are non-destructive to local user data.
revoke.claim_boundary: No remote revocation endpoint is called locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

claim_boundary: This is a local authentication-broker contract, not a live provider certification.
Credentials are referenced only as opaque handles; no tokens or secrets are stored or transported.
Live authorization, credential-store integration, and external provider evidence remain deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
